title: Technical Support Engineer
text:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About the Role:
As a Technical Support Engineer, you will be part of a highly skilled talented Customer Support team who work with CrowdStrike customers globally. The role involves working with CrowdStrike internal teams to resolve customer problems including troubleshooting, identification of root cause and issue resolution to help them receive the most benefit from their investment. The ideal candidate will have the energy and drive to discover and learn new technologies. Be fanatical about the customer, relentlessly focused on innovation and have limitless passion to drive their unlimited potential. This is a high energy, fast paced working environment that helps CrowdStrike achieve customer success.

What You’ll Do: 

As a Technical Support Engineer, you will be part of a highly skilled Customer Support team who support CrowdStrike customers 24x7 globally.Work in a dynamic and exciting technical environment with relentless focus on delighting our customers, partners and teammates.
Demonstrate ownership of customer’s concerns - assess impact, troubleshoot logically, engage relevant stakeholders, identify root cause and resolve them to the satisfaction of our customers.
Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders. Collaborate with them to resolve customer escalations quickly. 
Work with Product experts/Engineering to fix bugs or enhance product features.
Manage time and work to meet or exceed operational goals.
Learn cutting edge technologies and new product features.
Create/Share Knowledge articles and contribute to mentoring/training efforts.
May be scheduled to work on shifts/holidays as per the business requirement.

What You’ll Need: 

Experience in a Product Technical support role supporting Global enterprise customers.
Outstanding oral and written communication skills.
Customer focus. Analytical thinking and Logical troubleshooting aptitude.
Proven experience in troubleshooting and diagnosing issues at the application and operating system level within either Windows, Linux or Mac environments.
Understanding of operating system fundamentals including user and kernel space, memory management, shared libraries, file and network IO, Windows registry, software distribution, etc.
Hands on experience using the tools and techniques to debug problems within either Windows, Linux or Mac environments.
Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Bonus Points: 
ONE of the below specialization domains: 

SIEM/SOAR:
Hands on experience working on log management tools that offers self-hosted options & leverages kafka and/or containers.

title: Software Development Engineer III
text:
Company Description
ABOUT THE TEAM & ROLE:
At Swiggy, SDE III(s) play an integral role in owning end-to-end Design/Architecture of complex systems.They co-own the technology vision of the respective team and significantly contribute to the overall success of the team. They partner with the product/business teams to understand the product features and specifications, translate them into high level and low-level design thereby facilitating the team in design and development of mission critical applications.
Job Description
What qualities are we looking for?

*Proficient understanding of Web Fundamentals - HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript

*Proficient understanding of CSS pre-processing platforms, such as LESS and SASS or CSS in JS

*Proficient understanding of at least one modern UI framework  React (preferred), Vue, Angular, or similar;      experience with TypeScript is expected

*Experience with modern state and data-fetching patterns TanStack Query, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or m          equivalent  and monorepo tooling (Turborepo, Nx, pnpm workspaces)

*Experience with Webpack, Vite, TurboRepo, npm/pnpm, and CI/CD pipelines.

*Sound knowledge of design patterns and practices for writing clean, linted, maintainable and reusable code.

*Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, GraphQL, micro-frontends, and server-side rendering (SSR) vs.      static  site generation (SSG).

*Proficient understanding of cross-browser compatibility issues and ways to work around them.

*Strong grasp of performance engineering Core Web Vitals, bundle budgets, rendering performance — and    accessibility (WCAG) as first-class requirements

*Experience with TDD and unit/integration testing libraries (Vitest, Jest, Testing Library, Playwright/Cypress)

*Proficiency with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) — not just             autocomplete-level usage, but agentic workflows for large refactors, test generation, and code migration

*Strong judgment in reviewing and hardening AI-generated code: catching hallucinated APIs, security issues,  subtle correctness bugs, and architectural drift

*Ability to establish AI usage practices for a team  prompt/context conventions, guardrails, tool evaluation, and mentoring engineers on effective and safe AI workflows
What will you get to do here?
*Own end-to-end frontend architecture decisions rendering strategy, module boundaries, design systems for    complex, high-scale consumer products.

*Enable best practices to help the team achieve their technical tasks and continually thrive in improving the     technology of the product/team.

*Lead the team's adoption of AI tooling: define usage guidelines, evaluate new tools, and raise the bar for        how AI-assisted code is reviewed and verified.

*Develop user-facing features and apps, using AI tooling to move fast without compromising on quality.

*Build reusable code, libraries, and design systems for future use.

*Ensure the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs, using AI prototyping tools to explore and validate ideas     quickly

*Be extremely detail oriented to strive for pixel-perfect implementation across devices and viewports.

*Optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability, with measurable performance budgets.

*Understand the internals of third-party libraries being used, and know when to build vs. adopt
Qualifications
*Own end-to-end frontend architecture decisions rendering strategy, module boundaries, design systems for     complex, high-scale consumer products.
*Enable best practices to help the team achieve their technical tasks and continually thrive in improving the     technology of the product/team.
